Decided On: 09.12.2024 vs Khuda Baksh (Since Dead Through
His Lr) & ... on 9 December, 2024

Author: Sushil Kukreja
Bench: Sushil Kukreja

________________________________________________ The General Manager,
Northern Railway ....Appellant Versus Khuda Baksh (since dead through his Lr) & another
...Respondents Coram:
The Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sushil Kukreja, Judge.

Whether approved for reporting?1
_________________________________________________ For the
appellant: Mr. Shiv Pal Manhans, Senior Panel Counsel.
For respondent No. 1(a): Ms. Kavita Kajal, Advocate, vice Mr. Atharav Sharma,
Advocate.

For respondent No. 2: Mr. Navlesh Verma, Additional Advocate General, with Mr.
Gautam Sood, Mr. Raj Negi and Ms. Niyati Thakur, Deputy Advocates General.
Sushil Kukreja, Judge

The instant appeal filed by the appellant-General Manager,
Northern Railway, who was respondent No. 2 before the learned Reference Court,
under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act") against award dated 31.08.2011, passed by learned Additional District Judge,
Fast Track Court, Una, District Una, H.P., in 1 Whether reporters of Local Papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
2 Neutral Citation No. ( 2024:HHC:13818-DB ) LAC Petition No. 17/05 RBT 34/05/05, whereby the learned Reference Court enhanced the amount of compensation.

2. Admittedly, the land of the original claimant, i.e., late Shri Khuda Baksh (through his legal representative, i.e., respondent No. 1(a) Shri Mohar Deen) situated in Up Mohal Kasba, Mohal Basal, Tehsil and District Una, was acquired for public purpose, i.e., for construction of Nangal - Talwara Railway line, under the Land Acquisition Act (for short "the Act"), and to this effect notification was published under Section 4 of the Act on 15.02.2001.

The Notification was issued under Section 6 of the Act on 10.05.2001 and ultimately the Land Acquisition Collector, vide Award dated 14.09.2001, acquired the land as per the following rates:

Other gair mumkin 1313.00 3 Neutral Citation No. ( 2024:HHC:13818-DB )
3.

The original claimant, being dissatisfied with the amount of the compensation, awarded by the Land Acquisition Collector, preferred reference petition under Section 18 of the Act, before the learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Una, seeking enhancement of compensation.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Una
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The learned Additional District Judge, vide common award dated 31.08.2011, which was passed in the claimant's petition alongwith other connected petitions, re-determined the market value of the acquired land @ Rs.75,000/- per Kanal, irrespective of its classification and awarded the compensation alongwith all statutory benefits.
4. Feeling aggrieved, the appellant-General manager, Northern Railway, preferred the instant appeal with a prayer to quash and set-aside the impugned award, dated 31.08.2011, passed in Land Reference Petition No. 17/05 RBT 34/05/05, by learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court,
Una, H.P..
5.

Indisputably, similarly situated claimants, whose land was also acquired for construction of Nangal - Talwara Rail Line, had also filed land reference petitions before the learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Una, District Una, H.P., whereby a prayer for enhancement of the compensation awarded by Land Acquisition Collector was 4 Neutral Citation No. (
2024:HHC:13818-DB ) made.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Una, District Una, H.P.
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The above reference petitions were disposed of together, by way of impugned award dated 31.08.2011, whereby the learned Reference Court re-determined the market value of the entire land, irrespective of its classification on uniform basis and a sum of Rs. 75,000/-
per Kanal and the said award was reaffirmed by this Court in RFA No. 20 of 2010, titled as General Manger, Northern Railway vs. Rajinder Kumar & others, decided on 20.09.2016, alongwith connected matters.
6.

entities.text: General Manger, Northern Railway vs. Rajinder Kumar & others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned vice counsel appearing on behalf of respondent No. 1 (a) placed reliance upon the Decided On: 09.12.2024 vs Khuda Baksh (Since Dead Through His Lr) & ... on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166505637/
2 judgment passed in RFA No. 20 of 2010 (supra) and contended that the instant appeal be dismissed,
in view of the aforesaid judgment, as admittedly the claimant in the instant case alongwith the claimants in the above referred cases were awarded compensation vide a common award.

She further contended that since Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has already upheld the findings of the learned Reference Court, therefore, the claimant in the instant appeal is also entitled to market value of the entire acquired land, as granted by the learned Reference Court.

7. Shri Shiv Pal Manhans, Senior Panel Counsel, for the appellant, fairly admitted the factum of passing of 5 Neutral Citation No. ( 2024:HHC:13818-DB ) judgment in RFA No. 20 of 2010 (supra)
and he did not refute the claim of the claimant in the instant appeal to the effect that he is also entitled for enhanced market value of the acquired land, as has been determined in the aforesaid Reference Petition and which was the basis for enhancing the compensation in the award under challenge in the appeals and has further been upheld by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in RFA No.
20 of 2010 (supra) alongwith connected matters.

8. Hence, in view of what has been discussed hereinabove and also considering the fair stand taken by Shri Shiv Pal Manhans, learned Senior Panel Counsel, for the appellant, the instant appeal is dismissed and it ordered that the directions contained in RFA No. 20 of 2010 (supra), titled as General Manager, Northern Railway vs. Rajinder Kumar & others, decided on 20.09.2016, shall mutatis mutandis apply to the instant appeal as well.

entities.text: General Manager, Northern Railway vs. Rajinder Kumar & others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The appeal stands disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand(s) disposed of.

( Sushil Kukreja ) Judge 9th December, 2024 (virender)
